scopeProposal: PR #152 (Roman Mass and complete Hours, Byzantine and Traditional preserved)

tracker.title: [Ora V1] Full liturgical-day fidelity — tracker and chat handoff
tracker.goal: Canonical restart point: Roman Mass and the full Roman Liturgy of the Hours first; then independently source-verified Byzantine and Traditional liturgies; no release freeze until the chosen texts are genuinely Church-appointed, legally distributable or provided from an approved device-local source, and technically dependable.
rules: Roman Mass and the complete Hours share first priority; Morning Prayer is one example, not the limit.
Do not equate section presence or green CI with accurate official appointments/wording.
Use the current approved U.S. Roman Missal, Lectionary and Liturgy of the Hours as comparison standards; prefer official English.
Label every different translation, historical alternative, unresolved choice or missing section.
Do not silently choose unrelated texts, including cross-church Byzantine service material.
Preserve Today card simplification, purple fasting indicators and private saved books.
No freeze until source-backed parity evidence, publication path and iPhone acceptance pass.

tasks.title: Confirm Roman reference editions and U.S. calendar options
tasks.goal: Select the applicable approved U.S. Missal, Lectionary and Liturgy of the Hours editions for fidelity comparisons.
steps: Document exact reference editions and jurisdiction.
List US solemnity transfers and valid options in Mass and Hours.
Separate authorized text, alternative translations and unavailable content.
done: Versioned source links or book/page witnesses recorded.
Edition and optional-choice policy documented; no unofficial composite treated as authoritative.

tasks.title: Create a reusable full liturgical-day parity worksheet
tasks.goal: Develop a durable source-to-Ora comparison record for one representative weekday.
steps: Choose and record one dated ordinary weekday.
Inventory Mass and each Hour by part, appointment, text, translation, role, permitted options, evidence and discrepancy.
Distinguish wrong text from unknown source or optional variant.
done: A completed first-date worksheet with references, reproducible steps and next correction.
No protected source text reproduced in public test fixtures without permission.

tasks.title: Audit an ordinary weekday Roman Mass against the Missal and Lectionary
tasks.goal: Check one real day's Mass rather than simply proving that a saved EPUB section opens.
steps: Verify day-specific readings, psalm, acclamation and Gospel.
Verify entrance/Communion antiphons and Collect, Prayer over Offerings, Prayer after Communion.
Check Ordinary of Mass navigation, speaker labels and legitimate options.
done: Dated component-by-component comparison and severity-ranked defects.
Focused tests or linked small repair issues; no silent selection of optional Mass prayers.

tasks.title: Audit an ordinary weekday Roman Morning Prayer word by word
tasks.goal: Verify Lauds as prayed in the approved Roman Liturgy of the Hours.
steps: Check first-Hour Invitatory rule, opening, hymn and three-part psalmody/antiphons.
Check short reading, responsory, Benedictus, intercessions, Lord's Prayer, collect and conclusion.
Identify exact ICEL/ICET versus Douay-Rheims or historical alternatives.
done: All rendered sections mapped to source/edition or marked unavailable.
A discrepancy table and targeted test for each confirmed selection/order error.

tasks.title: Audit weekday Roman Evening Prayer for that same date
tasks.goal: Verify real Vespers for the weekday already covered by Mass and Lauds.
steps: Compare psalms, NT canticle, antiphons, reading and responsory.
Compare Magnificat antiphon, intercessions, Lord's Prayer, collect and dismissal.
Record differences in appointed content, wording, options and order.
done: Complete source-backed component matrix for one weekday Vespers.
Wrong or missing material tracked as a focused correction.

tasks.title: Audit a Sunday Roman Mass including vigil/day options
tasks.goal: Select one Sunday and compare the corresponding Mass against the official sources.
steps: Choose dated Sunday and note vigil/day form.
Compare readings, propers, creed and applicable Mass texts.
Test unambiguous choice vs alternatives in the local Missal.
done: One dated Sunday comparison with options identified.
Regression tests prevent wrong-form selection or hidden alternatives.

tasks.title: Audit Sunday Lauds and First/Second Vespers
tasks.goal: Verify the correct Sunday psalter, propers and Saturday evening precedence.
steps: Compare one Sunday Morning Prayer and both forms of Evening Prayer.
Check gospel canticle antiphons, psalmody, proper prayer and seasonal exceptions.
Test First Vespers selection and separate it from Sunday Second Vespers.
done: Three dated source-backed comparisons and targeted regressions.
No reused generic weekday material where the proper is required.

tasks.title: Audit Roman Night Prayer on two contrasting dates
tasks.goal: Verify weekday and Sunday/solemnity Compline against authorized sources.
steps: Compare structure, readings, antiphons, responsories, Nunc Dimittis and collect.
Check examination of conscience, Alleluia, conclusion and Marian antiphon options.
Test relevant first/second Vespers interaction.
done: Two distinct source-backed cases with passing targeted regressions.
Any unknown element explicitly identified.

tasks.title: Audit Invitatory and one Daytime Prayer hour
tasks.goal: Verify the first-Hour Invitatory choice and a representative daytime office.
steps: Check Invitatory presence/omission when another Hour is prayed first.
Audit one date and one of midmorning, midday or midafternoon: psalms, antiphons, reading, verse, collect.
Distinguish complementary psalmody/optional alternatives.
done: One daytime-office source comparison and Invitatory choice tests.
Missing components receive narrowly scoped follow-up issues.

tasks.title: Audit one complete Roman Office of Readings
tasks.goal: Establish fidelity for the real appointed biblical and patristic readings.
steps: Compare one day: opening, psalmody, first reading, second reading and responsories.
Determine when Ora shows official wording vs public-domain historical alternatives/links.
Record source and distribution limitations; split future reading imports by collection.
done: One whole Office comparison and specific missing/unverified component inventory.
No unrelated historical excerpt presented as appointed.

tasks.title: Check Mass/Hours coherence across three boundary dates
tasks.goal: Ensure Mass and the Hours reflect the same actual liturgical calendar while preserving legitimate differences.
steps: Test a Sunday-to-Monday boundary, a solemnity with First Vespers, and a transferred celebration.
Compare feast/rank/season selections in Today, Mass, readings and Hours.
Capture exceptions where multiple Masses or optional choices are legitimate.
done: A dated cross-module matrix and source-backed passing tests.
No silent mismatched saint, feast, rank or proper.

tasks.title: Audit section-level Roman translations and fallback labeling
tasks.goal: Expose approved versus alternate wording without cluttering Today cards.
steps: Inventory source/translation of the Mass and each Hour component.
Check UI labels for ICEL/ICET, Douay-Rheims, hymn alternatives, private source and unavailable text.
Design limited per-section display corrections.
done: Traceable provenance for compared sections.
No historical devotional passage represented as official current wording.
Compact Today cards unchanged.

tasks.title: Resolve licensed text delivery for public/offline Ora
tasks.goal: Establish a defensible path to official texts in a public installable PWA.
steps: Verify USCCB daily-reading RSS and accumulated JSON rights and PWA caching.
Review ICEL permissions separately from ecclesiastical authentication.
Compare official publisher link, licensed text and user-imported approved book modes.
Evaluate the existing references-only publication fallback without activating it prematurely.
done: Permissions/unknowns documented with primary sources.
Actionable release decision and any specific rights-holder inquiry prepared.
No assertion of approval that has not been granted.

tasks.title: Verify private Roman Missal EPUB navigation and optional texts
tasks.goal: Make device-local Missal navigation dependable without claiming automated choice of every Mass option.
steps: Test an ordinary day and an ambiguous or multiple-Mass heading.
Verify Extracted Collect, offerings/Communion prayers and Ordinary navigation.
Check preface, creed, Eucharistic Prayer and vigil choices remain explicit.
Preserve original device-local book and bookmarks.
done: Correct date selection or explicit ambiguity warning.
No inappropriate automatic option or loss of saved local content.

tasks.title: Audit one source-matched Melkite Divine Liturgy
tasks.goal: Compare one selected Melkite service against the original Newton edition and dated typikon.
steps: Choose verified service date/type.
Compare fixed prayer order, repetition, minister roles, optional petitions.
Verify dated hymns only where the Newton typikon supports the date.
done: One dated comparison with source citations and focused defect list.
No substitutions from Ukrainian or unknown services.

tasks.title: Audit one source-matched Ukrainian Divine Liturgy
tasks.goal: Compare the Ukrainian service against Edmonton/UGCC sources independently of Melkite.
steps: Choose verified dated service.
Check fixed text, responses, minister labels and church-specific propers.
Keep Edmonton December 24 conflict flagged; do not select guessed Basil.
done: One source-backed dated comparison and test coverage.
Unresolved eparchial/national discrepancies clearly identified.

tasks.title: Audit one Traditional/Sarum daily prayer and Mass
tasks.goal: Validate a representative historical Sarum day without conflating it with modern Roman rites.
steps: Select one documented date and historical text edition.
Compare calendar, Mass, prayer sections and translation labels.
Record anachronisms and uncertain variants.
done: One documented historical source comparison and small regressions.
No false modern Roman equivalence or invented history.

tasks.title: Confirm private books, updates, offline and accessibility on iPhone
tasks.goal: Carry out remaining real-device acceptance that browser emulation cannot prove.
steps: Check private PDF/EPUB save, close/reopen, bookmark, app update and airplane mode.
Check core daily tabs, selected rite, large text, dark mode and VoiceOver.
Record precise date, rite, view and reproduction for any defect.
done: Owner-device pass or concrete blocker list documented.
Same-SHA automated mobile/WebKit regressions remain green.

tasks.title: Reconcile stale PRs and run final evidence-based V1 release gate
tasks.goal: Declare V1 only after agreed liturgical and technical criteria are actually met.
steps: Compare stale open PRs with main and close superseded changes safely.
Reconcile all P0/open acceptance issues and documented exceptions with owner decisions.
Run Node, browser, WebKit and Pages checks on final SHA; record rollback point.
Complete iPhone acceptance and update README with accurate limitations.
done: All required V1 issues closed with evidence or explicitly rescoped.
Final commit SHA, CI/Pages URLs and iPhone signoff in tracker.
No V1 claim based solely on structural 462/462 coverage.
